content_sections.heading: Post-wise Details
content_sections.text: Qualification required: B.E./B.Tech in CS/IT or MCA; M.Tech/PG Degree in Statistics/Mathematics/Economics. Experience required: 5+ years. Pay: 15 – 25 Lakh. Qualification required: B.E./B.Tech/M.Tech in CS/IT/Electronics or MCA, preferably with Cloud Certification. Candidates having Cloud Certification with BCA/B.Sc./M.Sc. may also apply. Experience required: 3+ years. Pay: 12 – 20 Lakh.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: The CTC offered shall ordinarily not exceed 130% of the candidate's existing/previous pay drawn. Purely on contract basis Empanelment is for one year Engagement initially for an assessment period of three (03) months

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: Payment mode: Net Banking/IMPS. Last date to pay the fee: 6 December 2026.

content_sections.text: Document Verification Interview/Interaction Document verification and interview/interaction

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Original documents Self-attested photocopies of marksheets, degrees, testimonials Post qualification experience certificates Experience letter of current place of working Valid photo ID

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NIELIT Delhi Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Submit the Google registration form online. Pay the non-refundable registration fee of Rs. 750/- per position through Net Banking/IMPS. Submit separate applications for each post if applying for multiple positions. Apply on or before 6 December 2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Canvassing in any manner shall disqualify the candidate.
